_comment: The one list of the sbt modules in this repository. .github/scripts/check_modules.py (CI job 'Module registry check') fails if a file that hand-lists modules disagrees with it, naming the file and the line; to add a module, add it here first (dev/new-adapter does this for an adapter) and let the check say what else to edit. 'modules' is in dependency order. roles: engine (contract, ir, fingerprint, verification-core), kit (adapter-testkit), adapter (one per engine, spark-adapter first), harness (plugin, runner), extension (notification-kafka). 'published' modules go to Maven Central and run through the API-compatibility, coverage and release-dry-run loops; 'mutation' modules have a mutation-testing-<name> job in test.yml. 'sparkMatrix' modules are the ones whose change re-runs the Spark/Delta/Iceberg version matrices (spark-adapter and what it is built from; another engine's adapter has its own matrices and must not trigger these). 'doc' is an adapter's design write-up (docs/<ENGINE>_ADAPTER.md), which must exist and be rendered by contributor-docs/scripts/sync-docs.mjs; 'docStandard' (set by dev/new-adapter) also requires the generated headings and a ledger row for every capability, and 'status': 'complete' requires the write-up to have no TODO or open mark. 'built: false' modules are not built by dev/build and so need a CI job of their own.
